description: Na₄SiSe₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are three inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Se²⁻ atoms. There are two shorter (2.85 Å) and two longer (3.12 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a distorted pentagonal planar geometry to five Se²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.03 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Se²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.16 Å. Si⁴⁺ is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four Se²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Si-Se bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.29 Å. There are three inequivalent Se²⁻ sites. In the first Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na¹⁺ and one Si⁴⁺ atom. In the second Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Si⁴⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNa₅Si octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-54°. In the third Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na¹⁺ and one Si⁴⁺ atom.
